source: User-directed edit of demon-pixel-v3.png; generated transparent PNG copied unchanged.
prompt: Edit the attached game demon LOGO. Preserve the round black face, sinister grin and two short horns, centered transparent cutout, but RADICALLY REMOVE ALL TEXTURE AND SHADING. Strict flat high-definition pixel art silhouette: face and horns completely uniform pure black #000000. No gray anywhere on skin, no highlights, no gradients, no metal, no nose rendering, no outlined cheekbone or forehead features. Eyes are large hollow, pupil-less irregular blood-red sockets, flat #c60019, no glowing white pupils. Long uneven exposed sharp ivory teeth in an unnaturally wide grin. Horrific, menacing, unsettling rather than cute. Flat limited palette of exactly black, blood red and bone ivory plus fully transparent background. Crisp stepped pixel edges; no antialias blur. Fill 85 percent of square image; entire head and horns visible. No lettering, border, decorations or background.
